reuse.why: Fintegra reuses linkBankSyncAccount and both unlink paths share clearBankLink, but its downloader copies the existing Akahu implementation.

duplication.why: downloadFintegraTransactions repeats Akahu's authentication, request, error handling and response mapping as another complete downloader.

placement.why: Link policies remain in the shared account-link orchestration, provider downloads remain in sync.ts, and configuration and types follow existing module boundaries.

scope.why: The changes address the four requested steps, with supporting tests, provider metadata and release notes.

maintainability.why: Centralized link validation and extracted unlink state are straightforward to maintain, although the copied downloader creates another implementation to keep aligned.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All provider link handlers use linkBankSyncAccount, and both local unlink paths use clearBankLink.

disguised_duplication.where: sync.ts: downloadFintegraTransactions duplicates downloadAkahuTransactions with provider substitutions and a simplified const retVal declaration.

abstraction_drift.where: linkBankSyncAccount gains replaceExistingLink and a conditional replacement path; the closed-account and duplicate-link rules remain shared across every provider.
